segments.he:
א.

עַל־יְדֵי וִדּוּי דְּבָרִים גּוֹרְמִים שֶׁהַקָּדוֹשׁ־בָּרוּךְ־הוּא מַזְמִין מְלַמְּדֵי תִּינוֹקוֹת, שֶׁלּוֹמְדִין בֶּאֱמוּנָה.
segments.en: When there is peace with the government, through this there is born in Israel  (the Jewish people)  children who  (develop into)  instructors  (of the  halacha ) .

segments.he:
ב.

גַּם גּוֹרְמִים, שֶׁנִּתְקָנִים הַדְּרָכִים מִמִּכְשׁוֹלוֹת.
segments.en: One who is strict with others and lenient with himself, and claims he heard things he did not hear, through this he does not merit to see the beauty of the King. For the klipa  (evil force)  of  Edom , which is bad fear, darkens the light of his eyes so that he cannot gaze upon the beauty of the countenance of the King.

segments.he:
ג.

עַל־יְדֵי וִדּוּי דְּבָרִים זוֹכִים לְהִתְנַשְּׂאוּת.
segments.en: Through promiscuity, one falls into captivity, or sickness of pain in his feet. Also a student who has not reached the level of giving  (legal- halacha )  instruction and instructs, falls to this. Also, destructive forces dominate him.

segments.he:
ד.

מִי שֶׁאֵינוֹ מִתְוַדֶּה עַל עֲוֹנוֹתָיו, מוֹרָא בָּא עָלָיו.

segments.en: Through confession, this causes The Holy Blessed One to bring teachers of children who teach faithfully.
This also elicits fixing of the roads from obstacles.
Through confession, one merits to leadership  (to be elevated) .
One who does not confess his sins, [fallen] fear comes upon him.
